requirement: Use the Puzzle Date Chrome extension to embed every configured game while preserving a new-tab fallback when the extension is unavailable.

architecture.decision: Use a Manifest V3 declarativeNetRequest static ruleset to remove only iframe-blocking response headers from configured game subframes initiated by Puzzle Date. The React app embeds formerly blocked games only after the extension readiness handshake and otherwise preserves its new-tab fallback.
seams: Header modification applies only to sub_frame requests initiated by Puzzle Date and never to top-level browsing.
The app must preserve the existing external-game fallback whenever the extension readiness handshake is not ready.
The reset bridge must continue selecting only the visible active iframe, never a hidden preloaded frame.

tasks.title: Add scoped iframe header rules
tasks.intent: Extend the Chrome extension with a static Manifest V3 ruleset that removes iframe-blocking response headers for configured game domains only when they load as Puzzle Date subframes.
tasks.constraints: Header modification applies only to sub_frame requests initiated by Puzzle Date and never to top-level browsing. Preserve reset permissions and content-script behavior.
tasks.acceptance: The manifest registers an enabled ruleset, the rules target all configured external game domains, and only X-Frame-Options/CSP blocking headers are removed from Puzzle Date subframes.
tasks.result: Added and independently validated a Manifest V3 static ruleset for 11 configured game domains, scoped to Puzzle Date subframes and three remove-only iframe-blocking headers; bumped the extension to 1.0.4.

tasks.title: Embed games when extension is ready
tasks.intent: Change Puzzle Date so formerly external-only games render as iframes after the extension readiness handshake, while users without the extension retain the new-tab card and direct-open navigation.
tasks.constraints: The app must preserve the existing external-game fallback whenever the extension readiness handshake is not ready. The reset bridge must continue selecting only the visible active iframe, never a hidden preloaded frame.
tasks.acceptance: Every configured game is embedded for extension-ready users; missing-extension users still receive the existing external fallback; next-game preloading continues to exclude hidden frames from reset targeting.
tasks.visual: Test extension-ready and extension-missing states and confirm navigation, iframe visibility, fallback cards, and controls render correctly.
tasks.result: Added extension-ready effective embeddability for active and preloaded games while preserving the external card and automatic new-tab navigation when the extension is checking or missing; production build passed.

tasks.title: Package the enhanced extension
tasks.intent: Include the new ruleset in the downloadable extension ZIP, update installation guidance/versioning, and sync the verified files into the stable local extension folder.
tasks.constraints: The package must contain only manifest.json, background.js, content.js, and rules.json. Do not modify unrelated dirty files in the main workspace.
tasks.acceptance: The public ZIP contains the complete enhanced extension, the guide explains reloading/updating it, and the stable local unpacked copy matches the packaged version.
tasks.visual: Open the installation guide and confirm its download/update instructions are clear.
tasks.result: Added strict extension validation, reproducible four-file packaging, version 1.0.4 install/upgrade guidance, and byte-matched the stable local unpacked extension to the release sources; ZIP, build, hash, and comparison checks passed.

tasks.title: Validate and publish universal embedding
tasks.intent: Run final extension/app checks, verify every configured game domain against the embedding rules and browser behavior, publish the scoped release, and confirm GitHub Pages serves the new app and extension package.
tasks.constraints: Do not stage dependencies, generated build directories, or unrelated main-workspace files. Keep a working new-tab fallback for any site that still cannot render after header rules.
tasks.acceptance: All configured games either render inside Puzzle Date with the enhanced extension or retain a verified automatic fallback; Pages and the extension download deploy successfully.
tasks.verify: npm run build:pages && npm run package:extension && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs
tasks.visual: Navigate the complete rotation in a browser with the updated extension and confirm each iframe or fallback state, controls, and reset targeting.
tasks.result: Passed final build/validator/package/domain checks; real Chrome 1.0.4 testing embedded every game available today, repaired and visually confirmed Word Salad canvas preloading, verified Full Circle's Saturday-only domain preflight, published to branch/main, and confirmed successful Pages deployment, live Connections embedding, guide, and ZIP.
